build_ldm_vae: build a latent diffusion model variational autoencoder with ResNet encoder and decoder using ldm_variational_autoencoder
encode_VariationalAutoencoder: encode an input tensor through the VariationalAutoencoder to get a Normal posterior distribution
decode_VariationalAutoencoder: decode a latent tensor z through the VariationalAutoencoder decoder to reconstruct the output
run_VariationalAutoencoder_forward: run the VariationalAutoencoder forward pass to encode, sample from posterior, and decode in one step
create_VAEOutput: create a VAEOutput NamedTuple containing a posterior Distribution and decoder_output Tensor
